name: weather-availability-catalog
title: Weather availability catalog
description: Which weather products (station records, typical-year files, reanalysis, climate projections) are available where and for which years, with the evidence each statement rests on. Metadata only: no weather data. Exported from the openepw availability catalog.

licenses.name: CC-BY-4.0
licenses.title: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CMIP6 models so licensed, ERA5, OEDI, Open-Meteo)

licenses.name: other-attribution
licenses.title: Per-source terms; see README.md (NOAA, NSRDB, PVGIS, OneBuilding, Natural Earth)

sources.title: NOAA NCEI Integrated Surface Database: station history and inventory
Copernicus Climate Data Store: ERA5 and ERA5-Land
ECMWF ERA5-Land land-sea mask (ERA5-Land data documentation)
Pangeo CMIP6 catalog and WCRP CMIP6 source licences
OEDI 5974: Dynamically downscaled hourly future weather data (Argonne), doi:10.25984/2202668
Natural Earth 1:10m land polygons (public domain), for PVGIS coastal points
